blurb: Bowl Rite Lanes offers bowling on 24 lanes across two floors, with leagues for all skill levels and ages, parties for children and groups, and a full menu of food and drinks. The center has a bar, pool table, video arcade games, and a pro shop. It has been operating since 1965 and emphasizes a friendly, community atmosphere.
